content: {"slots": {"fuel_phase": {"value": "unknown", "quote": null}, "gravity": {"value": "microgravity", "quote": "DAFT / DAFT-2 tests that a modified P-Trak particulate counter would be accurate in microgravity."}, "flow": {"value": "unknown", "quote": null}, "atmosphere": {"value": "unknown", "quote": null}}, "functions": [{"function": "detection", "statement": "The investigation tests a modified particulate counter in microgravity to support more reliable and sensitive fire and smoke detection for spacecraft.", "quote": "This research will impact the development of novel fire and smoke detection systems for the International Space Station and future spacecrafts."}, {"function": "soot and smoke", "statement": "The work assesses whether a modified condensate nuclei counter can quantify smoke aerosols in microgravity by counting aerosol particles against a DustTrak control.", "quote": "SAME relied on a commercially available condensate nuclei counter, the TSI P-Trak, to quantify smoke aerosols in a microgravity environment"}], "statements": [{"statement": "The TSI P-Trak condenser was redesigned to recycle isopropyl alcohol by capillary forces, and the orientation-sensing mercury switch was removed.", "quote": "TSI P-Trak was modified for use in microgravity by redesigning the condenser tube to use capillary forces for recycling isopropyl alcohol and removing the mercury switch responsible for detecting instrument orientation."}, {"statement": "Arizona Red Dust was aerosolized with GN2 and the resulting aerosol was held in 15-liter Mylar bags.", "quote": "The ARD was aerosolized with GN2 to create particle samples. The aerosol was contained within 15-liter Mylar bags."}, {"statement": "On-orbit particle counts from the modified P-Trak were compared with a DustTrak CNC designed for microgravity.", "quote": "The modified P-Trak gathered data from counting aerosol particles and these data were compared to the DustTrak CNC specifically designed to work in microgravity."}, {"statement": "The stated microgravity failure concerns were isopropanol clogging or obscuring the system and over-counting caused by optics-chamber air flow.", "quote": "1) the system would clog or become obscured by isopropanol, and 2) the internal air-flow dynamics of the optics chamber of the device will cause an over counting of particulates."}, {"statement": "Testing was conducted on the International Space Station under the spacecraft fire safety subresearch area.", "quote": "SubResearch Area: Spacecraft Fire Safety"}]}
